convert_sana_checkpoint_to_diffusers_tra: convert a Sana PyTorch checkpoint to a diffusers SanaTransformer2DModel and save the transformer weights
convert_sana_checkpoint_to_full_pipeline: convert a Sana checkpoint to a full diffusers SanaPipeline with VAE, text encoder, and scheduler
convert_sana_sprint_checkpoint_to_pipeli: convert a SanaSprint checkpoint to a SanaSprintPipeline using the SCM scheduler
convert_sana_with_custom_scheduler: convert a Sana checkpoint to a diffusers pipeline using flow-dpm_solver or flow-euler scheduler
convert_sana_from_huggingface_hub: download a Sana checkpoint from Hugging Face Hub and convert it to diffusers format
